上午经N13公路俯瞰齐兹河谷万亩棕榈林，午后探访里萨尼夯土古城门并补充饮水，傍晚: In the morning, overlook the ten thousand mu palm groves of the Ziz River Valley along the N13 highway, visit the Rissani rammed-earth ancient town gates and replenish drinking water in the afternoon, and ride single-humped camels deep into the sand sea at dusk to photograph camel caravan sunset silhouettes.
上午自马拉喀什翻越2260米雪峰垭口南下，午后抵艾本哈杜拍筑垒村，日落前探访瓦尔: In the morning, cross the 2,260-meter snowy mountain pass south from Marrakech, arrive at Aït Benhaddou to photograph the fortified village in the afternoon, and before sunset explore the Fint Oasis hidden among the black basalt rocks south of Ouarzazate.
上午跟随当地向导徒步探访地下引水绿洲与菜畦沙墙交界带，午后避开烈日休息，傍晚从沙: In the morning, follow a local guide on a hike to explore the underground irrigation oasis and the boundary zone between vegetable plots and sand walls, rest in the afternoon to avoid the scorching sun, and freely step up the western foothills of the sand dunes at dusk to photograph blue-hour twilight.
上午驱车向西前往沃吕比利斯拍摄罗马柱廊与白山城同框，下午逛梅克内斯曼苏尔门外围或: In the morning, drive west toward Volubilis to photograph the Roman colonnade framed with the white mountain city, and in the afternoon tour the periphery of the Ismailian walls of Moulay Ismail in Meknes or return to Fes to buy handmade green glazed pottery.

下午15:00–17:00斜光照进近百米深的曲折峡谷壁面，凸显出红橙、灰绿、鹅黄: 15:00–17:00 in the afternoon with slanting light shining into the nearly hundred-meter-deep winding canyon walls, highlighting the alternating red-orange, gray-green, and buff-yellow geological chronological sedimentary layers.
下午16:00–18:30西晒夕阳从大西洋正面照射沙丘波纹，使沙丘呈现金红、海面: 16:00–18:30 in the afternoon as the westerly sunset shines from the front of the Atlantic onto the sand dune ripples, making the dunes render golden red and the sea surface render a deep gemstone blue.

下探至谷底溪流仰拍能最完整囊括整座石拱，切勿在雨天泥泞或体力透支时强行涉水攀爬光: Descending to the stream at the bottom of the valley and looking up allows you to capture the entire stone arch most completely; strictly avoid wading and climbing slippery limestone forcibly on rainy, muddy, or physically exhausted days.
不同于世人对北非只有沙漠的认知，海拔650–1700米的君士坦丁及提姆加德冬季偶: Unlike the public perception that North Africa consists only of deserts, Constantine and Timgad at elevations of 650–1,700 meters occasionally experience noticeable snowfall in winter! 不打算硬核登顶4167米雪峰的普通旅行者，完全可以在伊姆利尔山谷露台酒店住一晚，: Ordinary travelers who do not plan to hardcore summit the 4167-meter snow peak can easily stay one night at an Imlil Valley terrace hotel, and by taking a half-day light hike to the Aroumd terraced flower fields, they can reap top-tier snow-capped mountain village scenery.
与塔西利垂直砂岩石林风格迥异，此处属于花岗岩球状风化奇观，利用广角低角度贴近沙面: Quite distinct from the vertical sandstone stone forest style of Tassili, this place belongs to a granite spheroidal weathering wonder; using a wide-angle low-angle close-up against the sand surface to look up at the bizarre rocks has great visual tension.

两块巨石中间开阔平地是全毛里塔尼亚最魔幻的露营过夜点，远离任何村镇光害，午夜可直: The open flat ground between the two giant boulders is the most magical camping overnight spot in all of Mauritania, far away from any village light pollution. At midnight, you can directly use the silhouettes of these two alien monument-like monoliths as the foreground for the Milky Way taking off.
严寒晴朗 · 山顶冰封形成冰瀑线: Frigid and clear · Mountain peaks freeze to form icicle lines

中上旬仍偏炎热，下旬高原夜间开始重返清晰凉爽，适合首波秋天发烧友探索。: In early and mid-month it remains quite warm, while in late month plateau nights begin to return to clear coolness, suitable for the first wave of autumn enthusiasts to explore.
中上旬性价比高，植物园盛花延续，午后适合在Riad中庭泳池避晒。: Good value for money in early and mid-month, botanical garden peak blooms continue, afternoons are suited for escaping the sun in the Riad courtyard pool.
中下旬午后地表温度快速飙升，户外活动须压缩至清晨与日落后。: In late month afternoons surface temperatures rise rapidly, and outdoor activities must be compressed to early mornings and after sunset.
中下旬午后日晒强劲，须早起逛谢比卡/米德斯峡谷并于11:30–16:00转往马特: In late month afternoons intense sunshine is strong, requiring early starts to visit Chebika/Mides canyons and transferring to Matmata underground cave dwellings to escape the heat from 11:30–16:00.
中下旬恢复舒爽干燥，夕阳打亮金黄罗马柱廊且昼夜温差温和。: In late month, comfortable dryness returns, the sunset illuminates the golden Roman colonnades, and diurnal temperature ranges are moderate.
中下旬恢复舒适干爽，红色岩壁夕照质感饱满且游人明显少于10月。: In late month, comfortable dryness returns, the texture of the red cliff sunset glow is full, and tourists are noticeably fewer than in October.
中下旬气温大幅回落到宜人区间，刚经过漫长夏季的砂岩旷野干净无人。: In late month temperatures drop significantly into a pleasant range, and sandstone wildernesses that have just undergone a long summer are clean and deserted.
中世纪彩釉光束 × 黄金罗马石柱夕阳: Medieval glazed tile light beams × Golden Roman stone pillar sunset

乌里卡红岩七级飞瀑 → 拉拉塔凯尔库斯特湖 → 阿加菲石漠星夜: Ourika red rock seven-tier cascading waterfall → Lalla Takerkoust lake → Agafay stone desert starry night
乘4x4一路颠簸爬升进入阿塔科尔火山群核心，午间拜访黑岩清泉水潭，傍晚抵达特祖莱: Take a 4x4 bumpy climb up into the core of the Atakor volcanic group, visit the black rock spring water pool at noon, and arrive at the foot of the Tazoulet jagged mountains at dusk to camp and photograph black peak star trails.
乘4x4向东南大漠疾驰一整天进入赤红沙海腹地，攀上沙丘旁黑岩台守候撒哈拉最惊艳的: Take a 4x4 galloping southeast into the vast desert for a whole day to reach the depths of the crimson sand sea, climb the black rock platform beside the sand dunes to await the Sahara's most stunning vermilion red sand mountain sunset and light-pollution-free Milky Way.
乘TGM轻轨于Carthage Byrsa站下车后爬坡10分钟抵山丘遗址区与圣路: Take the TGM light rail, get off at Carthage Byrsa station, and climb the slope for 10 minutes to reach the hilltop ruins area and the St. Louis Church high viewing platform (pay attention to the restoration status of the St. Louis area).
乘国内航班飞抵绿洲贾奈特与向导车队会合，下午拍西斜光照耀下的“哭泣的牛”史前巨雕: Take a domestic flight to fly to the oasis town of Djanet to rendezvous with the guide and vehicle fleet, photograph the "Crying Cow" prehistoric giant carving illuminated by slanting afternoon light in the afternoon, and head straight to the edge of the sand sea at dusk to light the first Sahara sunset campfire.
乳白色晨雾顺着拉奥河谷漫上城廓边缘，西班牙清真寺宣礼塔与红土古堡尖顶若隐若现，蓝: Milky-white morning mist rolls along the Laou River valley to the edges of the cityscape, the Spanish Mosque minaret and red clay fortress spire loom vaguely, and the blue old town resembles a sky island floating on the hillside of the Rif Mountains.
云雾绕黑峰奇观 · 谨防火山砾石路山洪中断: Clouds and mist encircling the black peak wonder · Beware of flash floods cutting off volcanic gravel roads
云雾锁悬城 × 湿润古罗马大理石大道镜光: Clouds locking the suspended city × Moist ancient Roman marble avenue mirror light
人流全年最少，雨雾笼罩蓝色老街极具电影忧郁美感，提苏卡山巅偶见薄雪。: Tourist numbers are at their lowest of the year, rain and fog enveloping the blue old streets give a strong cinematic melancholic aesthetic, and thin snow is occasionally seen on Mount Tissouka's peak.
从伊姆利尔南端的Aroumd村出发，沿着Reraya河床岩石步道徒步向上约2–2: Starting from Aroumd village at the southern end of Imlil, hike up for about 2–2.5 hours along the rocky trail of the Reraya riverbed to reach the sanctuary settlement marked by white-painted boulders.
从伊姆利尔（1740米）聘请持证山野向导徒步约5小时至3207米大本营木屋夜宿，: Hire a certified mountain guide in Imlil (1,740m) and hike for about 5 hours to the Toubkal Refuge at 3,207m for an overnight stay. Start the summit push at 3:30 AM the next morning, ascending the scree and snow slopes for about 3.5 hours to reach the peak.
从伊维克村或R’Gueïba码头搭乘伊姆拉根渔民无动力传统木帆船顺着海风与潮水穿: Take a traditional engineless wooden sailing boat of the Imraguen fishermen from Iwik village or R’Gueïba pier, riding the sea breeze and tide across the strait for about 1.5 hours to reach the sandbar island of Tidra.
从北侧圣殿悬崖（Cathedral Point）俯拍海湾长浪角度无敌；村口悬崖路: An unbeatable vantage point from Cathedral Point on the north side to overlook the long ocean swells of the bay; simple, authentic grilled fresh fish stalls line the cliffside road at the village entrance, perfect for a seafood lunch with an ocean view.
从南侧峡谷半山腰石阶平视与乘坐潭底五彩小木舟近距离贴瀑仰拍各有震撼，穿防滑雨鞋或: Both viewing from the stone steps halfway up the southern canyon and getting up close to the base of the waterfall on a colorful wooden boat offer breathtaking perspectives. Wear non-slip rain boots or bring moisture-resistant lens cloths to counter the dense spray, and remember not to feed the macaques.
从哈桑二世清真寺沿Boulevard de la Corniche海滨步道向西南: Stroll southwest for about 20 minutes (or a 3-minute taxi ride) from the Hassan II Mosque along the Boulevard de la Corniche seaside promenade to reach the black volcanic reefs beside the lighthouse.
从塔曼拉塞特出发沿着东南或北侧红岩山麓花岗岩走廊行车约45分钟即可走进遍布巨卵石: Drive from Tamanrasset for about 45 minutes along the granite corridor of the southeastern or northern red rock foothills to walk into the Tagrera natural sculpture garden strewn with giant boulders.
从塔曼拉塞特沿险峻碎石盘山公路乘4x4越野车上行约3小时（约80公里）抵达山腰营: Take a 4x4 from Tamanrasset along the steep, winding gravel mountain road for about 3 hours (approx. 80 km) to reach the mid-mountain camp. Before dawn the next day, put on a headlamp and hike up the steep stone steps for about 25 minutes to reach the summit of the plateau.
从布马勒纳达德斯沿R704蜿蜒峡谷公路向北深入约27公里，直抵Tisdrine悬: Head north from Boumalne Dades along the R704 winding canyon road for about 27 kilometers, leading directly to the Tisdrine cliff viewing café terrace parking area.
从廷吉尔镇沿R703公路向北溯谷行车约15公里，柏油路直穿峡谷最窄底部，谷口外即: Drive north from Tinghir town along the R703 road into the valley for about 15 kilometers. The paved road runs straight through the narrowest bottom of the canyon, and parking is available right outside the canyon mouth.
从提姆加德或巴特纳向南沿着N31壮丽山路穿行奥雷斯山脉（经阿里斯）约1.5小时车: Drive south from Timgad or Batna along the N31 magnificent mountain road through the Aurès Mountains (via Arris) for about 1.5 hours to reach the canyon-top roadside viewing gallery.
从斯帕特尔角沿着大西洋长滩海岸路向南行车约6分钟，洞口外设有正规旅游停车场，购票: Drive south from Cape Spartel along the Atlantic long beach coastal road for about 6 minutes. A formal tourist parking lot is available outside the cave entrance, where you can buy tickets and descend the steps into the sea cave.
从梅尔祖卡向南沿铺装路及沙石道驱车约30分钟至塔乌兹一带无人戈壁或沙漠南缘荒野营: Drive south from Merzouga along paved roads and dirt tracks for about 30 minutes to the uninhabited gobi or southern desert wilderness camps around Taouz.
从梅尔祖卡或哈西拉比德营地乘4x4越野车越过外围沙舌后，在黎明前约50分钟徒步沿: Take a 4x4 from Merzouga or Hassi Labied camp past the outer sand tongues, and hike along the non-slip windward ridge for about 50 minutes before dawn to reach the summit.
从梅尔祖卡镇东缘各沙漠营地骑单峰驼或步行约25分钟进入西麓起伏沙丘群。: Ride a dromedary or walk for about 25 minutes from the desert camps on the eastern edge of Merzouga town into the undulating sand dune fields on the western foothills.
从老城东口拉斯埃尔马山泉桥出发，沿石板山道向东南爬升约20分钟即可抵达山脊平台。: Start from the Ras el-Ma spring bridge at the eastern gate of the old town, and climb southeast along the flagstone mountain path for about 20 minutes to reach the ridge platform.
从舍夫沙万向东经林区公路驱车约40分钟至塔拉塞姆塔内国家公园林站（建议雇四驱车及: Drive east from Chefchaouen via the forest road for about 40 minutes to the Talassemtane National Park forest station (hiring a 4x4 vehicle and a local ecological guide is recommended).
从舍夫沙万市区包车或乘Grand Taxi约45分钟抵达阿克舒尔谷口停车区，随后: Charter a car or take a Grand Taxi from Chefchaouen for about 45 minutes to reach the Akchour valley parking area, then hike along the Fardara river valley for about 1.5–2 hours to reach the grand waterfall.
